title: Entrainment versus station keeping: an index condition for Kármán gaiting (code and outputs)
description: Code and saved outputs for the manuscript 'Entrainment versus station keeping: an index condition for Kármán gaiting' by Y. Aydoğan and O. Akanyeti. The scripts compute passive equilibria, entrainment at fixed position, station-holding orbits with their Floquet multipliers and fixed-position branches, numerical continuation and bifurcations, noise and experimental predictions, and every figure and table of the paper.
